zh.title: 美國航空航班電腦起火 傳4至5名乘客燒傷
zh.summary: 美國航空航班筆記型電腦起火；空服員控制設備；傳4至5人燒傷
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 22 日發布的報導，美國航空（American Airlines）一架客機在飛行途中發生筆記型電腦起火事故。執勤的機艙空服人員隨即對空中緊急情況進行處置，並成功控制了該起火的個人電子設備。
初步消息顯示，這起筆記型電腦起火事故造成多名乘客受傷，據報導有 4 至 5 名乘客不幸遭到燒燙傷。機組人員於客機艙內及時控制住起火裝置，減輕了飛航過程中的進一步安全危害。

en.title: Laptop Catches Fire On American Airlines Flight Injuring Passengers
en.summary: Laptop catches fire on American Airlines flight; crew contains device with multiple passengers reportedly injured.
body: According to reports published by Simple Flying on August 22, 2026, a laptop computer caught fire on board an American Airlines flight. Flight attendants working inside the aircraft cabin intervened during the in-flight occurrence and successfully contained the thermal event involving the personal electronic device.

Initial reports indicate that multiple passengers sustained injuries when the device caught fire inside the passenger cabin. Specifically, reports state that four to five passengers suffered burn injuries during the incident. Flight attendants acted to control and contain the burning laptop on board the aircraft to ensure passenger safety.
